question: In a code language, 'RAM' is written as 'Q14' and 'CAR' is written as 'B19'. How will 'MARK' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

'RAM' is written as 'Q14'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abe2d0f4ced8b1efbddf125cefb82fdcbd75ca54c003689f6f8b45a7c2d85752.png] 

And

 'CAR' is written as 'B19'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db78bf5288e917604120e13f153bec84374d9a81841d590a5015d54cb48e7576.png] 

Similarly,

 'MARK' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33f0f93bc90c84536b97085dd2dd527e0eb71e71d6670214724f672aeee9bc23.png] 

Thus, 'MARK' is written as **'L 30'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
